svg.title: Toolkit - languages, AI and backend, frontend, tooling, linked to the featured projects
svg.desc: Toolkit, with project markers 01 LinguaFlow, 02 NEXORA FPT, 03 SportFieldBookingApp. Languages: primary Python (01), TypeScript (01, 02); also JavaScript, Java (03), PHP (03), Kotlin, C#. AI and backend: primary FastAPI (01), LangGraph (01), PostgreSQL with pgvector (01); also LangChain (01), WebSocket (01), MySQL (03), SQL. Frontend: primary Next.js (01, 02); also React (01, 02), Tailwind CSS (02). Tooling and platforms: Docker (01), Git, Firebase (03), Android (03), ZegoCloud (03), VNPay (03).
